The '''Heavy Lifter''' was a spacecraft produced by [[Patel Ironwerks/Legends|Patel Ironwerks]], significantly larger than the [[Utility Tug/Legends|Utility Tug]] manufactured by the competing [[Nicholas/Gordon Spacewerks/Legends|Nicholas/Gordon Spacewerks]].

==Characteristics==
Commonplace throughout the Galaxy, this craft could be seen towing heavy loads from place to place. The craft had powerful [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beams]] that gave it the ability to manipulate and haul loads far greater that its own mass.

Unlike a Utility Tug, the Heavy Lifter was fitted with a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], so it could be used for intra-system ferrying and haulage.

===Variations===
[[File:Heavy_Lifter_Comparison.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Different versions of the Heavy Lifter.]]
Patel Ironwerks produced two different versions of the Heavy Lifter:

====Type 1====
Mottled in color, the '''Type 1''' had a significantly different array of intakes on its nose section when compared to the Type 2. Also, this version had a much smaller, blue-tinted front viewing window.

====Type 2====
The '''Type 2''' Heavy Lifter was a more uniform gray color, and often sported brown identification markings. The nose appeared to have fewer intakes, and on the roof to the rear of the vehicle there was a prominent circular device of indeterminate function. This design also had an entryway on both sides of the vehicle.

==Notable craft==
*''[[Atlas]]''<ref name="XWA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Type 1 Heavy Lifter was featured only in ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter]]''. Possibly due to the improvements made to the graphics engine, all subsequent games that were released used the Type 2 design.
